title: Deploy OVH systemd/Compose, Cloudflare Access, and read-only status projection
oracle: Service restart self-heals without local/launchd/Agent dependency; public UI is protected by Cloudflare Access; status projection is read-only.
threshold: All blocking assertions PASS; UNKNOWN, NOT_RUN, and WAIVED are not PASS.
result_summary: Latest-main contracts were preserved. OVH systemd recreated the v0.0.0.5 Compose core without durable-data change, authenticated Cloudflare control-plane IDs and live WAF/rate-limit behavior were verified, and the exact read-only status projection recovered while preserving the existing status site.
